name: TestVanDammeAnim + BroBase base states
note: Every entry names the fields that steer ChangeFrame (TestVanDammeAnim.cs:4023-4210) to one Animate* method, the field the frames are stepped with, and the cells the base sprite sheet holds for it. Bare :NNNN line references are TestVanDammeAnim.cs; BroBase.cs is named explicitly. Expected cells were cross-checked against the sprite validator's base range table. The harness re-applies setup before every step, so animations that clear their own flag mid-sequence still run to the end of their column span. An entry with knownMismatch addresses fewer cells than its expect says for a reason the source explains, and the driver reports it separately from a real mismatch. An entry marked lethal kills or respawns the live player, so the driver leaves it out unless --include-lethal is passed. The harness patches UseSpecial, UsePockettedSpecial, PerformKnifeMeleeAttack and PerformPunchAttack out for the duration of a sweep, so the states that walk those frames fire nothing at the level.

states.note: AnimateWallAnticipation :4455-4468 (row 3 columns 16-21 and 26-31) picks its column from Y + knifeClimbStabHeight - lastKnifeClimbStabY (:4453), a delta against the position where the knife was last planted. A static field value cannot express it, and the dispatch at ChangeFrame :4183-4186 also needs left/right plus canTouchLeftWalls/canTouchRightWalls, which are set by wall contact.
